description: Side Saddlebag Mounts Hepco-Becker C-Bow for Honda CB1000R from 2008 to 2017.
source_description_html:
Side Saddlebag Mounts Hepco-Becker C-Bow for Honda CB1000R from 2008 to 2017.

Choose the C-Bow system, the perfect solution for using side saddlebags with great practicality!

These mounts are specially designed to blend harmoniously with the design of your bike while maintaining a safe distance from the exhaust. They easily attach to the existing points on your vehicle.

Installing the bags is simple: just slide them onto the C-Bow systems. A key lock mechanism ensures their security, protecting them against theft.

Additionally, if you prefer luggage from other brands, the "female" mounting element is available separately for optimal adaptation.
